description: This file defines a class 'WorkShiftMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface for configuring menu items related to 'WorkShift' in the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes traits and references to core menu and screen entities to override the current screen context.

classes.name: WorkShiftMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu items related to 'WorkShift' in the OrangeHRM Admin module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'workShift' using a helper method and returns null.
